A vignette head-and-shoulders full face portrait of a Mangbetu woman wearing a twisted metal loop neck ornament, with a pendant hanging from it. She is also wearing metal arm ornaments and has a series of dotted cictrices on her abdomen. Buchta made an excursion to the groups west of the Nile in 1879 setting out from Juba on 7th July and returning there on 26th August.
'Mangbetu infant wearing bands to elongate the head'.

A large heap of earth near a settlement which is visible beyond. The heap has been placed over a wooden structure which sticks through it along the sides, and has a forked branch placed near the front, with earth on top of ?thatching grass. This suggests that Zande custom of constructing a hut over a grave before making an earthern heap, later replaced by a stone one at a mortuary ceremony.
